intro: Zinge's Delivery is a courier task dispatched by Apothecary Renferrel from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. It transports strangely toxic wolf heart tissue back to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity for formal study by the Royal Apothecary Society.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens. There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!
It's quite incredible, and we must study it further. I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired. Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge. You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke. I am eager to experiment with these... It is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
